## Context / Problem

`src/rebar/_store/hlc.py:35-41,60-66,137-156` still honors `REBAR_HLC=0`, although `docs/remediation-implementation-plan.md:590-592` calls it a one-release rollback and many releases have since shipped. Disabling HLC can reintroduce causal-ordering errors under skewed clocks. The removal also affects compaction-concurrency scenarios that used the switch for timestamp placement and a seam guard that counts its `# read-via:` marker.

## Approach

Remove `_enabled`, the `REBAR_HLC` environment read, and the disabled raw-clock branch. Retain `REBAR_HLC_NOW` as the test-only physical-clock injection, legacy event reads, persisted-state locking, and deterministic clock tests. The generated environment reference must change through removal of the implementation read; no separate deprecation-registry entry exists to delete.

Migrate the two compaction integration scenarios without disabling HLC. Scenario A will build its far-past subject from a fresh clone with no HLC cache, then use strictly ordered forward `REBAR_HLC_NOW` values for the young event, snapshot, and remote append; each tick is monotonic and the test proves the append sorts after the snapshot without a wall-clock race. Scenario B will create B’s below-snapshot orphan while B’s remote is disconnected and before B witnesses A’s future snapshot, using a valid injected future timestamp. After A publishes the higher future snapshot, reconnect B and drive a real engine write/push to merge and publish the pre-existing orphan; the test continues to prove detection and repair.

Update all removal consumers: generated environment documentation, event-schema staging prose, the mechanism baseline, HLC unit tests, `test_store_paths` cleanup, the concurrency scenarios, and the held-out seam-marker budget. In the held-out guard, reduce both `_MARKER_BUDGET["_store/hlc.py"]` from 2 to 1 and its exact-count `_TOTAL_MARKER_CAP` from 5 to 4, including the adjacent budget comment. Add a focused exact-name sweep/oracle so `REBAR_HLC` cannot reappear while the distinct `REBAR_HLC_NOW` injection remains allowed.

## Scope

- HLC implementation and generated environment reference
- generated/operator and event-schema documentation plus the mechanism baseline
- unit/store/integration/held-out consumers of the retired switch
- a focused exact-name removal oracle

## Testing

Run the HLC unit suite, store-path test, both real push/fetch/merge compaction scenarios, the held-out snapshot-I/O seam guard, the environment-reference generator/check, lint, and typecheck. Use deterministic injected values and explicit cache/remote preconditions rather than wall-clock timing.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The HLC implementation contains no `REBAR_HLC` disable branch or environment read; `REBAR_HLC_NOW` remains the sole test-time physical-clock override.
- [ ] Regenerating the environment reference after removing the implementation read produces no `REBAR_HLC=0` entry; `docs/event-schema.md` and completed-remediation guidance no longer describe it.
- [ ] `.github/mechanism-baseline.json` no longer contains the retired `env_var::REBAR_HLC` mechanism entry.
- [ ] Scenario A constructs its far-past ticket from a clone with an empty HLC cache and uses ordered forward injected clock values to prove the remote append sorts after the snapshot with HLC continuously enabled.
- [ ] Scenario B writes its below-snapshot orphan while disconnected before it can witness A’s higher snapshot, then reconnects through a real engine write/push and still proves orphan detection plus snapshot repair.
- [ ] In `tests/scripts/test_store_snapshot_io_seam_clean_heldout.py`, removal of the HLC read-via marker lowers `_MARKER_BUDGET["_store/hlc.py"]` from 2 to 1, `_TOTAL_MARKER_CAP` from 5 to 4, and the associated budget comment so the exact-total guard remains valid.
- [ ] HLC unit and store-path tests preserve legacy event readability, injected-clock behavior, and canonical HLC-state placement without setting or clearing `REBAR_HLC`.
- [ ] A focused exact-name scan/test fails if `REBAR_HLC` is reintroduced outside the explicitly retained `REBAR_HLC_NOW` injection contract.
- [ ] The HLC, store, concurrency, seam-guard, environment-reference, lint, and typecheck suites pass.
